description: Submits an advisory consultation request directly into the TWVS executive pipeline with fail-fast validation. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'submit_consultation_inquiry' on TWVS Advisory & Consulting (twvs.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'list_practice_areas' or 'get_partner_ecosystem' or 'check_consultation_slots' for their respective operations). Parameters: name (required), company (optional), email (required), phone (required), division (required), interest (required), message (required), preferred_date (optional), preferred_time (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Creates a live record/session in the backend database; no authentication required for public initiation; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

company.description: Optional institution, hospitality group, or business name.

division.description: Target TWVS practice division (TV Consulting, WV Consulting, or General Advisory). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

email.description: Business email address of the requester. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

interest.description: Primary advisory discipline (e.g. Capital Markets, ISO 20022, Reconciliations, API Security, Restaurant Costing). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

message.description: Specific operational challenge, project scope, or advisory requirements. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

name.description: Full name of requesting executive or representative. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

phone.description: Direct contact telephone number. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

preferred_date.description: Optional preferred consultation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

preferred_time.description: Optional preferred time window (e.g. 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM SAST).

name: submit_consultation_inquiry
title: Submit Consultation Inquiry
